description: Search published BikerLink REAL services and offers from active PB and SS locations, with controlled Italian, English, German and Spanish keyword variants for motorcycle travel. This is keyword/concept matching, not full natural-language AI interpretation. Only records explicitly marked human_verified:true and verification_status:verified_by_human_agent have been attested by an authorized human agent, on-site or via live video (see verification_method). Other records may be confirmed by the manager or by phone. Prices and availability refer to the stated verification date, not real time.

free_only.description: Show only activities with a verified free service/offer matching the requested service
